title: OpenAI buys 750 MW of Cerebras inference compute (over $20B)

sources.quote: In January 2026, we announced a multi-year deal with OpenAI valued at more than $20 billion dollars.

In December 2025, we entered into a Master Relationship Agreement (the “MRA”) with OpenAI OpCo, LLC (“OpenAI”), under which OpenAI agreed to purchase 750MW of AI inference compute capacity (the “Committed Capacity”) and related services, including collaboration on engineering development and integrations.

explain: OpenAI agreed to buy 750 megawatts of AI computing from Cerebras, delivered in stages from 2026 through 2028, to make ChatGPT answers faster. Cerebras says the deal is worth more than $20B (the amount shown is that floor); OpenAI can also buy up to 1.25 GW more. News reports at announcement put it at about $10B.
